mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand, which typically translates to stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods with HOUST above 1000.0 thousand units over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of periods with PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) typically triggers central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods with rising CPIAUCSL over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signal weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of periods with HOUST < 1000.0 over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods with INDPRO and GDPC1 declining over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) combined with rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and monetary tightening (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%)
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods meeting the high inflation and tightening regime over the last 5 years.
